newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly lower in after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly lower in after-hours.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly lower in the after-hours session on Thursday, as the bearish mood from the day's session remained, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen lower to 0.2 yen higher against the day's close. The benchmark April contract was 1.0 yen lower at 142.0 yen per kg.
During the day, active selling from local investors emerged due to the yen's gains against the dollar, the traders said.
Light technical buying supported some contracts, but the market mood remained bearish, they said. The drop in domestic rubber stocks encouraged buyers, a brokerage trader said.
